g.title: EVCC
g.text: Current coordinator transaction at 346c11f | bounded by owner Tick

g.title: failure
g.text: Fault / expiry / evidence loss / explicit Stop

g.title: safe
g.text: Retain command result + starting hardware sequence

g.title: tail
g.text: 3a Wire fixture checks safe / zero-current hardware
Retain HLC / PLC for bounded protocol tail

g.title: teardown
g.text: HLC cancel / transport close -> PLC StopLink
Repeated calls retain result; no automatic physical retry

g.title: wait
g.text: Pending: retain DENY and observe status
Hardware result alone is not safe confirmation
HLC / link ACCEPTED requires IDLE / DOWN evidence

g.title: latch
g.text: Incomplete physical confirmation or async teardown

g.title: caveat
g.text: Measured SAFE: current generation / newer hardware sequence, before deadline,
open contactors, inactive precharge, zero measured current; evidence remains fresh.
Unplug does not erase a pending stop. Late callbacks cannot revive a session.
Physical retry/fallback and watchdog if the owner stalls remain vehicle/target work.
